# Flowi Workflow — AI reading guide

Product: Flowi Workflow by AI Flowi
Canonical docs: https://docs.aiflowi.com/
GitHub: https://github.com/ai-flowi/flowi-docs

Use this order when helping a user build a Flowi workflow:

1. https://docs.aiflowi.com/AI_START_HERE/
2. https://docs.aiflowi.com/ai/TASK_ROUTING_INDEX.json
3. https://docs.aiflowi.com/ai/VERIFIED_WORKFLOW_RECIPES.json
4. https://docs.aiflowi.com/ai/COMPONENT_INDEX.json
5. Relevant category under https://docs.aiflowi.com/ai/components/
6. https://docs.aiflowi.com/ai/EXTENSION_COMPONENT_INDEX.json when an extension is required
7. Relevant human tutorial or integration page
8. Full built-in index only for cross-category search

Core public rules:
- Prefer AVAILABLE components.
- Label BETA.
- Avoid LEGACY for new workflows.
- Validate built-in typed edges.
- Never invent undocumented fields or capabilities.
- Never request secrets in public chat.
- Teach the student step by step and include a test after each major stage.

High-value pages:
- What is Flowi: https://docs.aiflowi.com/getting-started/what-is-flowi/
- AI tutor: https://docs.aiflowi.com/getting-started/ai-tutor-mode/
- Tutorials: https://docs.aiflowi.com/tutorials/
- Telegram: https://docs.aiflowi.com/integrations/telegram/
- Google Sheets AI automation: https://docs.aiflowi.com/tutorials/webhook-to-google-sheets/
- FAQ: https://docs.aiflowi.com/faq/
- When Flowi fits: https://docs.aiflowi.com/evaluate/when-flowi-fits/
- Feature status: https://docs.aiflowi.com/reference/feature-status/
